entries.name: Trading market data resolution
entries.description: Known first-party read-only market-data implementations for trading research and signal generation.

implementations.name: OKX OnchainOS DEX Market Skill
constraints: Read-only on-chain market/signal research; no wallet signing or transaction broadcasting

implementations.name: OKX CEX Market Skill
constraints: Market Skill must be imported/selected; no API credentials required for its read-only market commands

implementations.name: Coinbase Market Data Skill
constraints: Use only supported market-data surfaces; market lookup authorizes no trade

implementations.name: Kraken Market Intel Skill
constraints: Requires Kraken CLI for direct execution; Skill itself may still be used as procedural knowledge

implementations.name: Alpaca Market Data Skill
constraints: Useful for US equities/news/streaming; exact feed availability depends on Alpaca account/data plan

implementations.name: CCXT unified public market data
constraints: Use public/read-only exchange endpoints only; exchange coverage and fields vary

entries.name: DeFi research resolution
entries.description: Known first-party DeFi analysis/planning implementations for PAPER trading research.

implementations.name: OKX OnchainOS DEX Market Skill
constraints: Use read-only token, liquidity, holder, cluster, trader and signal analytics only

implementations.name: Aave Yield Analysis Skill
constraints: Use Aave market/yield queries only; do not submit transactions from the PAPER trading Project

implementations.name: Uniswap Liquidity Planner Skill
constraints: Use for planning/analysis; any swap or liquidity action remains outside PAPER execution authority

implementations.name: Uniswap Swap Planner Skill
constraints: Planning only in Rakazo Trading; do not pass through to live swap execution

implementations.name: OKX OnchainOS DeFi Skill
constraints: Use discovery/rates/portfolio analysis only in PAPER project; deposits, withdrawals, claims and other writes remain forbidden

entries.name: Paper trading resolution
entries.description: Known first-party paper-trading/backtest workflows. This semantic key is Market knowledge and does not grant trading.execute.

implementations.name: Alpaca Paper Trading Skill
constraints: Paper environment only; never substitute live Trading API credentials or endpoints

implementations.name: Alpaca Paper Trading MCP Skill
constraints: Paper environment only; MCP assignment must not expose live execution for Rakazo Trading

implementations.name: Kraken Paper Strategy Skill
constraints: Paper commands only; live execution Skills remain unavailable to the PAPER Project

implementations.name: Kraken Paper Strategy Backtest Recipe
constraints: Simulation/backtest only
